notes: Scripts create named conda envs via conda create -n <name> python=<version> pip
Scripts install repo-specific deps and then link API checkout via eval_system_api.pth
Scripts default to repo paths inside API-test when present
LingBot env script can install README package set plus optional post-training extras
LDA env script installs requirements.txt plus flash-attn and editable repo
RoboTwin env script can run official installer or manual requirements fallback
